findingDetails.title: Public ripgrep wrapper is out of parity with the hidden-document retrieval lane
findingDetails.evidence: Read-only import of the wrapper builders and assertRecipeParity returned three divergences: every shared-lane recipe contains --hidden and !**/.git/** while wrapper recipes contain neither.
findingDetails.recommendation: Align wrapper recipes with shared-lane flags and add dotted-path plus .git parity fixtures.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Current source comparison and direct module import; no target writes.

adjudication.claim: The public wrapper silently searches a different corpus from the shared lane.
adjudication.counterevidenceSought: Compared all recipe vectors and imported assertRecipeParity; it returned three divergences.
adjudication.alternativeExplanation: An intentional public-only corpus is not declared and conflicts with the parity contract.
adjudication.downgradeTrigger: Explicitly narrow the wrapper contract and parity target to a declared alternate corpus.

findingDetails.title: Copyable retrieval recipes omit the mandatory .git exclusion
findingDetails.evidence: The prose calls --hidden and !**/.git/** mandatory, but all copyable structured, path, count, context and anchor commands omit the .git glob.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the .git exclusion to every prose recipe and assert documentation parity.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared mandatory flag paragraph with every copyable recipe block.

findingDetails.title: Wrapper silently discards positional arguments after the phrase
findingDetails.evidence: parseArgs destructures only the first two positional values; direct import with path, foo, bar returned phrase foo and dropped bar without an error.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject extra positionals or explicitly join them and test the chosen contract.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Current parser source and read-only parseArgs probe.
